files.title: File:Two photographs of 1807 Tytus Avenue, Middletown, Ohio - DPLA - 4cd272e373a4329e439c752754d4d956 (page 1).jpg
files.caption: Two photographs of 1807 Tytus Avenue, Middletown, Ohio. Photographs are undated. The real estate listing for 1807 Tytus Avenue reads: 1800 Block, good 7 room modern house. Has 5 rooms on first floor, reception hall, fireplace, oak floor, knotty pine and sun room. Two big bedrooms and bath on second floor. Warm air furnace with stoker. Two-car garage.
